items.question: How does a JVTO booking work?
items.answer: Choose a tour, submit lead guest details at checkout, pay the required amount (deposit or full payment), then receive your Official E-Voucher / Invoice (PDF) as formal confirmation.

items.question: How much is the deposit?
items.answer: Standard deposit is 20% of the total booking value.

items.question: When can full payment be required at checkout?
items.answer: If Day 1 is within 14 days, JVTO may require up to 100% full payment at checkout.

items.question: When is the balance due if I paid deposit?
items.answer: By card: no later than 5 days before Day 1. By bank transfer/Wise: no later than 3 days before Day 1. Cash (IDR) is only if approved in writing and settled at the JVTO office before departure.

items.question: What happens if I cancel 48 hours or more before Day 1?
items.answer: Guest-initiated cancellations at ≥48 hours convert 100% of payments received into JVTO Package Credit (not cash refund).

items.question: What happens if I cancel less than 48 hours before Day 1 or no-show?
items.answer: Late cancellations/no-shows may be forfeited up to 100%, with no Package Credit or cash refund normally provided.

items.question: Where do I find the binding rules?
items.answer: Use /policy/booking-payment-cancellation and your Official E-Voucher / Invoice (PDF). If anything differs, the voucher/policies take precedence.
